answer: Locks are logged in zenith, expire in ferrous, and pearl lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 58 aliases as a result needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4623 identities would post 4956 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
